def sha(body):

def identity(path):

expected = expected.replace("REVISION = '17e0284496bab10c7632a48e4f91efb6fb4fec0b'", "REVISION = '0093cf60d881a177634ce1a2247e053fc9d2b94e'\nNATIVE_REVISION = '17e0284496bab10c7632a48e4f91efb6fb4fec0b'")

expected = expected.replace("observed.get('source_revision') != REVISION", "observed.get('source_revision') != NATIVE_REVISION")

def verify_source(revision, source, run_dir):
    assert git(source, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == revision
    assert git(source, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all') == ''
    entries = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', revision], cwd=source).decode().split('\0')[:-1]
    count = 0; symlinks = 0; submodules = []
    for entry in entries:
        metadata, name = entry.split('\t', 1); mode, kind, expected_blob = metadata.split()
        path = source / name
        if mode == '160000':
            assert git(path, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD') == expected_blob
            assert git(path, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all') == ''
            submodules.append({'path': name, 'revision': expected_blob, 'status_clean': True})
            continue
        body = os.readlink(path).encode() if mode == '120000' else path.read_bytes()
        actual_blob = hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(body)).encode() + b'\0' + body).hexdigest()
        assert actual_blob == expected_blob, name
        count += 1; symlinks += mode == '120000'
    before = json.loads((run_dir / 'source-before.json').read_text())
    for row in before:
        assert sha((source / row['path']).read_bytes()) == row['sha256'], row['path']
    submodule_status = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'submodule', 'status', '--recursive'], cwd=source, text=True)
    lines = submodule_status.splitlines()
    assert len([line for line in lines if line.startswith(' ')]) == 5
    assert len([line for line in lines if line.startswith('-')]) == 3
    return {'source': str(source), 'revision': revision, 'tree': git(source, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'),
            'all_superproject_git_blobs_match': True, 'blob_count': count, 'symlink_count': symlinks,
            'source_before_sha256': identity(run_dir / 'source-before.json')['sha256'],
            'source_before_rows_match_current': len(before), 'status_clean': True,
            'top_level_submodules': submodules, 'recursive_submodule_status': submodule_status,
            'initialized_top_level_submodules': 5, 'uninitialized_nested_cvfpu_gitlinks': 3}

receipt['sources'] = [verify_source(revision, source, run_dir) for revision, source, run_dir, _ in RUNS]
